visual_action: A slideshow of two photographs of Jimmy Carter. The first is a color photo of him as an elderly man, smiling in front of an American flag. The second is a black and white photo of him as a younger man, smiling at a podium with microphones.

cast.name: Jimmy Carter
cast.evidence: The on-screen text reads "Happy 99th birthday to former President Jimmy Carter" and he is the only person shown in the photographs.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in this video.
audio_music: A gentle, melodic acoustic guitar track ('Relaxing Vibs' by Haseeb) plays throughout the video, creating a warm, respectful, and celebratory tone.
central_claim: The Democratic party is wishing former President Jimmy Carter a happy 99th birthday.
intended_effect: To generate feelings of warmth, respect, and admiration for Jimmy Carter and, by extension, the Democratic party.
